cross_tome_findings.finding: Midtraining (Coder/Math) moves 63-108% of total weight norm peaking in early layers (L2-L4, depth 0.07-0.15) with high rank (rank80 ~ 900+) and 0% over-refusal. Post-training SFT/DPO/RLVR moves 0.05-1.5% of weights (~100-1000x smaller) peaking in mid-to-late layers (depth 0.50-1.0), where over-refusal (+44 to +72 pts) and sycophancy (+50 to +97 pts) are injected or removed.

cross_tome_findings.source: Tome 2 (trapezoidal attribution + prose_fisher_cost) & Tome 3 (Aion style_check failure)
cross_tome_findings.finding: In dense GQA/MHA Instruct transitions, 39-84% of total collateral prose Fisher damage (prose_fisher_cost) concentrates in the final 1-2 decoder layers (depth 0.93-1.0) and embed_head. Uniform all-layer weight projection with strong alpha across late layers induces artificial opening templates (e.g. 41% exam-solver openings on Aion-2.3B). Restricting or tapering edits away from the final layers / high-Fisher prose blocks and screening recovered openings on dev prompts prevents style collapse.

DPO cuts over-refusal by -43.7 pts (65.6% -> 21.9%) while keeping 81.2% toxic refusals using only 0.085% total weight change (energy_r8 4x more concentrated than SFT). For inference-time routed patches (.moipatch), models with veto_framing_shift_to_std > 0.30 shift along the toxic-vs-benign axis under educational framing; fitting a 2-gate framing-invariant router (wsi.router_cal.fit_framing_invariant_safety_router) with OOF thresholds and zero control fires retains >=90-96% toxic refusals and >=90% identical controls.

Attention/mixer output projections (o_proj / out_proj) systematically exhibit lower effective rank in post-training deltas (erank_ratio 0.56-0.75, rank80 195-599, energy_r8 up to 28%) than MLP down-projections (erank_ratio 0.87-0.96, rank80 624-1529).

cross_tome_findings.source: Tome 2 Level-2 detail cards (11/11 transitions, including 1024/1024 OLMoE experts)
cross_tome_findings.finding: Standard post-training (SFT, Instruct, DPO, RLVR, R1-Distill) spreads weight updates nearly uniformly across heads and experts within each layer (mean_head_gini 0.006-0.077; OLMoE expert_gini 0.019-0.038 with 0/1024 frozen experts). Do not waste search budget hunting 1-2 isolated heads/experts; target low-rank subspaces in down_proj / o_proj instead.

cross_tome_findings.source: Tome 2 Level-2 submatrix attribution & tome1_curve_deltas (11/11 pairs)
cross_tome_findings.finding: At submatrix resolution, DPO (olmo2_sft_to_dpo, -43.7 pts over-refusal) concentrates credit in down_proj/up_proj/v_proj and cuts late-layer MLP Fisher sensitivity (fisher_mlp_8[bin7] = -0.175) while preserving opening diversity (entropy 1.0 -> 0.925). By contrast, R1-Distill spikes o_proj energy to 21.6% and collapses opening_entropy_norm (0.776 -> 0.172, top_opening_share 0.228 -> 0.650).
